Calgary, Alberta--(Newsfile Corp. - September 15, 2026) - Primary Hydrogen Corp. A total of 911,489 common shares were voted, representing the votes attached to 12.29% of all outstanding common shares of the Company. All matters submitted to shareholders for approval as set out in the Company's Notice of Meeting and Information Circular (the "Circular"), dated July 31, 2026, were approved by the requisite majority of votes cast at the Meeting. A summary of the voting results is outlined below.

Number of Directors

The number of directors of the Company was set at four (4).

Election of Directors

David Jackson, Benjamin Asuncion, William Timothy Heenan, and Martin Kowcun were re-elected as directors of the Company for the ensuing year.

Appointment of Auditor

DMCL Chartered Professional Accountants were re-appointed as auditors of the Company for the ensuing year with the remuneration to be fixed by the directors.

Approval of New Equity Incentive Plan

An ordinary resolution was passed, approving the Company's new up to 10% rolling and fixed up to 10% omnibus equity incentive plan.

Primary Hydrogen is dedicated to the exploration and development of natural hydrogen resources. With over 740 acres in the U.S. and 230 square kilometers across Canada, the Company's portfolio includes the Blakelock, Hopkins, Mary's Harbour, Point Rosie, Crooked Amphibolite, Coquihalla, and Cogburn projects. Primary has an option to acquire a 75% interest in a hydrogen-REE project known as Wicheeda North located in British Columbia.

Nineteen projects across northern Illinois selected through the ComEd Powering the Arts Grant Program

CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--ComEd and the League of Chicago Theatres today announced the recipients of the 2026 Powering the Arts Grant Program. Celebrating its ninth year, the program is awarding a total of $205,000 to 19 nonprofit organizations across northern Illinois. These funds will support a range of arts initiatives, from youth creative development to engaging community experiences.

“ComEd is proud to partner with the League of Chicago Theatres to support local arts programs that enrich our neighborhoods,” said Melissa Washington, senior vice president of Government, Regulatory and External Affairs at ComEd. “This year’s recipients continue to advance that mission. Each project celebrates the vibrancy of our communities, and they collectively expand access to live performances, music education, community festivals and opportunities for creative expression for the people we serve.”

Since its launch in 2018, the Powering the Arts Grant Program has awarded nearly $1.5 million in grant funding to support over 150 different arts and cultural projects within the ComEd service territory. ComEd and the League of Chicago Theatres work closely together to administer the program. Grant applications are reviewed by an external panel of judges, and grant recipients match the award funding with their own investment of equal or greater value towards their project.

“Arts and culture enrich our neighborhoods and play an essential role in building thriving communities,” said Executive Director of the Chicago League of Theatres Marissa Lynn Jones. “As we enter the 2027 grant season, our ongoing partnership with ComEd reflects a shared commitment to strengthening the arts sector and expanding access to creative experiences across our region. By supporting local arts organizations, we are helping them deepen their community impact, engage new audiences, and contribute to more vibrant, connected, and resilient communities.”

ComEd remains committed to working with local organizations to invest in projects that improve quality of life for northern Illinois residents. The Powering the Arts Grant Program is one of ComEd’s four Power for Good grant programs empowering communities across northern Illinois together with the Powering Safe Communities Grant Program, the Green Region Grant Program and the Powering the Holidays Grant Program.

More information about ComEd grant opportunities is available at ComEd.com/Grants.

The 2026 ComEd Powering the Arts Grant Program recipients and their funded projects include:

Paramount Arts Centre, Inc (Aurora) will expand its programming that creates meaningful opportunities to experience live theater with more targeted theater engagement events serving more than 500 Aurora educators, nurses, first responders, veterans and seniors.

Mandi Theater (Buffalo Grove) will expand its accessibility initiative throughout its 10th Annual International Theatre Festival by removing financial, linguistic, and engagement barriers.

John Walt Foundation (Chicago, Austin) will expand its six-week Summer Apprenticeship Program, providing 20 to 25 West Side youth with paid creative arts and workforce development opportunities.

The Chicago Mosaic School (Chicago, Edgewater) will relaunch its Teaching the Teachers program, providing affordable mosaic arts training to approximately 200 local educators who collectively serve more than 3,000 students.

The World Music Foundation (Chicago, Edgewater) will present 22 live world music sessions for approximately 660 seniors and families, bringing global music experiences directly to those living in Chicago affordable housing communities.

UrbanTheater Company (Chicago, Humboldt Park) will launch Cruzando Generaciones (Crossing Generations), a weekend theater workshop series for Humboldt Park and surrounding area high school students that connects teens and older adults through theater, storytelling and oral history.

Uniting Voices (Chicago, Hyde Park) will expand upon and launch new North Lawndale school programs to provide choral instruction and performance opportunities impacting up to 300 students.

Culture Shock Chicago NFP (Chicago, Lincoln Park) will expand its Shockwaves hip-hop arts program to rural northern Illinois schools and communities who currently have limited arts access, reaching approximately 3,000 students and community members.

Young People's Theatre of Chicago (Chicago, Lincoln Park) will launch the Student Access Initiative aimed at expanding access to live theater for approximately 1,500 students from 25 Chicago Public Schools through free tickets and transportation assistance.

Midnight Circus in the Parks (Chicago, Lincoln Square) will bring four free circus performances, interactive juggling activities and dedicated transportation from a local senior center to Brighton Park, providing access for up to 1,600 attendees.

Villapalooza Inc. (Chicago, Little Village) will expand its free Little Village Arts and Music Festival that includes local and national artists, community resources and ongoing public engagement, reaching more than 3,000 attendees.

The Joffrey Ballet (Chicago, Loop) will present Joffrey for All, a free outdoor dance performance at Gallagher Way expected to reach up to 3,000 people.

Project H.O.O.D. (Chicago, South Side) will launch its first dedicated theater and performing arts program which will provide 40 to 60 children in Englewood and Woodlawn with free theater training before a public community showcase.

TimeLine Theatre Company (Chicago, Uptown) will provide Chicago teens with a free six-week summer program combining theater training, professional mentorship and a paid opportunity to create original performances.

Illinois Conservatory for the Arts (DuPage) will launch the IMPACT Access Initiative to provide free or low-cost performing arts opportunities to approximately 250 students and create pathways into scholarships, return events and audition preparation.

Elgin Youth Symphony Orchestra, Inc. (Elgin) will provide free after-school violin and viola instruction and instruments to fourth-grade students across the Fox Valley region.

Angels Athletics (Flossmoor) will expand its Angels in the Arts programming through artist workshops, cultural outings, dance and an intergenerational musical production serving youth, families and seniors.

Freeport Art Museum (Freeport) will expand Paint the Port to include more live music and additional sponsored painting opportunities for approximately 1,500 participants and visitors.

Spotlight Performance Academy (Homewood) will launch a new senior community choir in Homewood and Flossmoor, engaging at least 60 seniors in music and intergenerational performances.

ComEd is a unit of Chicago-based Exelon Corporation (NASDAQ: EXC), a Fortune 200 company and one of the nation’s largest utility companies, serving more than 10.7 million electricity and natural gas customers. ComEd powers the lives of more than 4.2 million customers across northern Illinois, or 70 percent of the state’s population. Cascade 100P and Lenovo ThinkEdge power live AI deployments across the Kingdom

ANN ARBOR, Mich. and RIYADH, Saudi Arabia, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MemryX, a provider of power-efficient, scalable AI acceleration technology, today announced that it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Lenovo to expand the deployment of sovereign edge AI solutions across Saudi Arabia.

The agreement builds on joint platform deployments already operating in the Kingdom and establishes a framework for Lenovo and MemryX to pursue additional opportunities across infrastructure, industrial operations, smart cities and video management. The collaboration supports Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 by enabling organizations to deploy practical AI capabilities while maintaining greater control over their data and computing infrastructure.

The joint platform combines the Lenovo ThinkEdge SE455 V3 rugged edge server with the MemryX Cascade 100P AI accelerator to process video and sensor data on site. This helps organizations reduce latency, maintain greater control over their data and limit reliance on centralized, power- and cooling-intensive AI infrastructure.

"Working with Lenovo demonstrates how quickly MemryX technology can move from evaluation into demanding, real-world deployments," said Ross Jatou, Chief Executive Officer of MemryX. "Together, we are delivering high-density, power-efficient AI inference close to customer operations and establishing a platform that can scale from Saudi Arabia to markets worldwide."

The joint platform is already operating in large-scale infrastructure programs in Saudi Arabia. One deployment delivers real-time construction safety analytics, including personal protective equipment compliance and site safety event detection. A second deployment operates in a port environment, running compliance and site-monitoring workloads across the operator's existing camera infrastructure without disrupting ongoing operations.

"We're seeing growing interest from organizations across Saudi Arabia that want to use AI in practical ways, whether that's improving safety, making operations more efficient, or gaining faster insights from their data," said Salman Faqeeh, Vice President and General Manager, Saudi Arabia, Lenovo. "What matters to customers is being able to do that while keeping their data close to where it's created and under their control. That's why our work with MemryX is relevant and timely. Together, we're helping bring AI into real-world environments where it can make an immediate difference. What's even more relevant is that this isn't a future concept. We're already seeing this deployment help customers improve safety and efficiency in real operating environments across Saudi Arabia. The fact that these deployments are already operating in Saudi Arabia shows how quickly organizations are moving from AI experimentation to real-world adoption."

The MOU establishes a framework for Lenovo and MemryX to expand customer deployments in Saudi Arabia, pursue opportunities across infrastructure and industrial markets, validate the platform through a Lenovo Center of Excellence, and develop additional solutions through Lenovo AI Innovation. Aligned with a hybrid edge-to-cloud strategy, the companies also intend to explore rack-scale server configurations for computer vision inference, supporting potential regional and global go-to-market opportunities.

About MemryX
MemryX Inc. is a fabless AI semiconductor company delivering power-efficient, scalable inference acceleration from the edge to the data center. Its production-proven, compute-near-memory dataflow architecture powers a portfolio of accelerator silicon, modules and systems designed to make AI easier to integrate and deploy. Learn more at memryx.ai.

About Lenovo
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Guided by its vision of "Smarter Technology for All," Lenovo is executing a Hybrid AI strategy that spans Personal AI—one personal AI, multiple devices—and Enterprise AI, helping customers turn data into insights and value.

This strategy is delivered through the Group's commitment to world-class innovation and a full-stack AI portfolio, including devices such as PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets and accessories; infrastructure solutions spanning servers, storage, edge, high-performance computing and software-defined infrastructure; and software, solutions and services. With a global footprint spanning more than 20 research and development locations and a global supply chain that includes more than 30 manufacturing sites across 11 markets, Lenovo is widely recognized for its operational excellence.

Thunder Bay, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 15, 2026) - Metals Creek Resources Corp. (TSXV: MEK) (OTC Pink: MCREF) (FSE: M1C1) ("Metals Creek") and Benton Resources Inc. (TSXV: BEX) ("Benton") (Benton and Metals Creek collectively referred to as the "Companies") are pleased to announce the receipt of TSX Venture Exchange approval for the previously announced (August 18, 2026 new release) joint acquisition from G2B Gold ("G2B") of an interest in 2 mineral licenses encompassing 50 claim units (the "Properties") in the Deer Lake Basin (20 units) and Parsons Pond (30 units) area, subject to 2% net smelter royalty (NSR) to G2B, on the basis of 50% ownership to each of Benton and Metals Creek. No finders' fees were paid pursuant to this acquisition.

The Companies, which are non-arm's length, acquired 100% (50% Benton and 50% Metals Creek) of G2B's interest in the Properties in consideration of:

  • the issuance to G2B of 120,000 common shares of Metals Creek and 82,500 common shares of Benton; and

  • a 2% NSR on the Properties subject to the Companies having the right, at any time, to purchase one half of the NSR (i.e. 1%) by paying $1 million to G2B.

About Metals Creek Resources Corp.

Metals Creek Resources Corp. is a junior exploration company incorporated under the laws of the Province of Ontario, is a reporting issuer in Alberta, British Columbia and Ontario, and has its common shares listed for trading on the Exchange under the symbol "MEK". Metals Creek has earned a 50% interest in the Ogden Gold Property including the former Naybob Gold mine, located 6 km south of Timmins, Ontario and has an 8 km strike length of the prolific Porcupine-Destor Fault (P-DF).

Metals Creek has also jointly acquired through staking on a 50/50 basis with Benton Resources, potential natural white hydrogen projects in Newfoundland. The Smoking Gun Prospect was selected after research uncovered highly anomalous helium with values up to 8,900 parts per billion (ppb) in water collected from an historic drill hole. These licenses are located within the Deer Lake Basin, which is thought to be a prospective environment for the presence Helium (He) and Natural (White) Hydrogen (H₂).

At Parson's Pond, research of historical drill logs in two holes 14.2 km apart, have observed C1 methane gas levels reaching 72%. The area is underlain by thrust faulted rocks of the Humber Arm Supergroup. Drill logs indicate unique sedimentary units composed of shales along with sandstones containing fragments of serpentine and chrome. Of particular interest, is the presence of the mineral glauconite, which, combined with these geological indicators, suggests a highly prospective environment for the potential formation of white hydrogen, (natural hydrogen) to form within the basin. The presence of such high concentrations of methane alongside hydrogen indicators suggests a potentially active gas system within the basin. MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Polaris continued its dominance in SCORE series this past weekend, sweeping the UTV Overall podium at the 7th SCORE Baja 400. Piloting his Polaris RZR Pro R Factory to the UTV Overall win, Wayne Matlock claimed Polaris' $50,000 SCORE Challenge prize purse. Joining Matlock on the podium with a second-place finish was RZR Factory Racing Team driver Ethan Groom and Dallas Gonzalez, who rounded out the all-RZR Pro R Factory podium sweep with a third-place finish.

Behind Matlock, Groom delivered another strong performance for the RZR Factory Racing Team. Starting third in Pro UTV Open, Groom battled throughout the day to secure second overall, while Gonzalez followed in third to give Polaris a clean sweep of the UTV Overall podium and further showcase the performance, durability and depth of Polaris' purpose-built race platform.

Announced in July, the SCORE Challenge was created to raise the level of competition within the UTV Pro class, offering a $50,000 prize to any eligible UTV racer who could defeat the RZR Factory Racing team and capture the UTV Overall victory. Matlock answered the challenge, adding Baja 400 to his decorated off-road racing career.

"Wayne put together an incredible race, and we couldn't think of a more deserving competitor to be the first to claim the Polaris SCORE Challenge," said Alex Scheuerell, Polaris' Director of Off-Road Motorsports. "We created this challenge to raise the stakes and fuel competition, and Wayne did exactly that. To see him earn the victory and the $50,000 prize aboard a RZR Pro R Factory, while Ethan and Dallas completed an all-RZR Pro R Factory podium, speaks volumes about the strength of this vehicle and the racers who continue to push it to its limits."

The podium sweep further underscores the growing presence of the RZR Pro R Factory race vehicle across off-road racing, extending well beyond Polaris' factory-backed RZR Factory Racing team. Developed from the same platform that has powered RZR Factory Racing to victories across the sport's most demanding desert races, the purpose-built race vehicle is increasingly being chosen by independent racers looking to compete at the front of the field. That growing adoption was on full display at this year's Baja 400, with RZR Pro R Factory machines securing five of the top ten finishing positions.

PONTE VEDRA, Fla., Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Treace Medical Concepts, Inc. (“Treace” or the “Company”) (NasdaqGS: TMCI), a medical technology company driving a fundamental shift in the surgical treatment of bunions and other foot & ankle conditions, today announced it will highlight multiple new product innovations and present clinical data at the American Orthopaedic Foot & Ankle Society (“AOFAS”) Annual Meeting in Seattle, Washington from September 16-19, 2026.

"We are excited to showcase our expanding portfolio of best-in-class foot & ankle innovations at AOFAS 2026," said John T. Treace, CEO, Founder and Chairman of Treace. “This year, we will be featuring several new technologies aimed at advancing our leadership in the bunion market, while also extending our reach into the mid and hindfoot market which allows us to more comprehensively service our surgeon customers’ needs.”

Technologies to be featured in surgeon training events and at Treace’s AOFAS exhibit booth:

Latest Advancements to Treace’s Market-Leading 3D Bunion Correction Portfolio  

  • Lapiplasty® Lightning™ System: Featuring next-generation instrumentation to accompany the SpeedTMT® implant technology, designed to provide surgeons with ultimate control of their 3D bunion correction, while reducing surgical steps for a faster procedure.  
  • Tailorplasty™ MIS Tailor’s Bunion System: A minimally invasive solution for the surgical treatment of tailor’s bunions, or “bunionettes”, which are painful deformities of the 5th metatarsal estimated to affect approximately 5-10% of the adult population.
  • Treace™ X-ray App: Cloud-based software for making radiographic measurements in foot and ankle X-rays, putting anatomical measurements at the fingertips of surgeons.

New Innovations Expanding Treace’s Reach into the Mid and Hindfoot Markets

  • SuperBite™ Fully-Threaded Compression Screws: Comprehensive system of self-drilling screws designed to reduce steps and save time in fusion and osteotomy procedures, addressing a broad range of foot & ankle applications across the forefoot, midfoot, and hindfoot.
  • HyperPlate™ XM Dynamic Compression Locking Implant: Advanced fixation construct combining locking screws and dynamic compression for a highly stable construct with an anatomic shape designed to promote fusion in the larger bones of the midfoot and hindfoot.
  • CartiBlaster™ Powered Joint Prep instruments: Sterile, single-use instruments designed for fast and controlled cartilage removal and joint preparation in fusion procedures throughout the midfoot and hindfoot.
  • VitaFuse™ Bioactive Glass Graft: A new synthetic bone graft technology that expands our growing biologics portfolio, which includes our tissue-based CortiFuse™ graft and procedure specific wedges.

Results highlighting the clinical performance of Treace technologies in the landmark 5-year ALIGN3D® Lapiplasty®, MTA3D™ Adductoplasty® and SPRINT™ SpeedPlate® studies will be presented during the AOFAS Annual Meeting.

Clinical Data Presentation Schedule

  • Friday, September 18 at 8:45am PST: The ALIGN3D® Lapiplasty® clinical study podium presentation, “Five-Year Analysis of a Prospective Multicenter Study of Triplanar Tarsometatarsal Arthrodesis With Early Weightbearing: Radiographic, Clinical and Patient Reported Outcomes”, will be presented by Daniel Farber, MD, Lehigh Valley Orthopedic Institute (Bethlehem, PA).

Enterprise decision intelligence company adopts the name of its methodology as it builds vertical software one industry at a time

SEMINOLE, OK / ACCESS Newswire / September 15, 2026 / Cyphaira Corp. (OTCID:CYPA), formerly Growth Stalk Holdings Corp (OTC:GSTK), announced that its corporate name change to Cyphaira Corp. is complete and that its common stock began trading on OTC Markets under the new symbol "CYPA" at the open of trading on September 10, 2026. The stock traded as "GSTK" through the close of trading on September 9, 2026. The CUSIP number of the common stock is unchanged.

The name and symbol change does not affect the company's shares outstanding, the rights of shareholders, or the company's reporting obligations. Shareholders are not required to take any action; brokerage accounts reflect the new name and symbol automatically as the change is processed by FINRA and DTC. Filings made before the change remain under the Growth Stalk Holdings Corp name.

Cyphaira is an enterprise decision intelligence company. It builds business decision-intelligence software one vertical at a time, using one methodology: Understand, Decide, Act, applied by operators who do the work. Its first product, SolvixLMS, is an operating system for regulated manufacturing environments: seven integrated suites designated production-ready by management, source-verified at 583,041 first-party source lines as of August 24, 2026. Additional verticals are in development. The Company has not yet recognized revenue from SolvixLMS.

The Company was originally organized around state-licensed cultivation and processing operations in Oklahoma. The Company is divesting the four subsidiaries that hold those operations to a newly formed entity. The Board of Directors has approved the transaction and a definitive agreement has been prepared; closing is expected upon transfer of the applicable state licenses.

"Businesses don't need more information. They need intelligence," said Joseph Babiak, Chief Executive Officer. "Every system a company runs holds a piece of reality, and none of them understands the business. We build software that does, one industry at a time, with the people who do the work. The new name is the method."

About Cyphaira Corp.

Cyphaira Corp. (OTCID:CYPA) is an enterprise decision intelligence company headquartered in Seminole, Oklahoma. It builds business decision-intelligence software one vertical at a time using its Understand, Decide, Act methodology, applied by operators who do the work. Its first product, SolvixLMS, is an operating system for regulated manufacturing environments. Cyphaira Corp. is the new corporate name of Growth Stalk Holdings Corp, an Oklahoma corporation.

Cyphaira Corp. is divesting the four subsidiaries that hold its legacy state-licensed cultivation and processing operations. The transaction has been approved by the Board of Directors and is expected to close upon transfer of the applicable state licenses.
